name: AXM Evidence Chain Recovery Foundry
actions: bind an inspection receipt to the exact selected evidence segment
refuse non-hash structural or metadata anomalies
rechain an in-memory candidate after explicit authenticity acknowledgement
download candidate JSONL and a separate digest-only receipt
summary: Creates a source-bound, independently re-inspected structural rechain candidate without modifying the original or claiming recovered truth.
notes: Candidate-only and explicit-download-only. Rehashing cannot prove payload authenticity or restore history. The Foundry never discovers live state, overwrites, applies, recovers, starts the server, promotes or changes CANON.
